Name: Timberline Falls
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
TimberLine Falls is a new expansion that introduces 23 new NPCs, quests, special orders, machines, and so much more. There's lots of room for activities. To visit Timberline, all you have to do is take the tunnel by the train station. If they ever open it again. *shakes fist*

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Bustling town featuring 23 new NPCs, Ethical Big Box Store Buyco, and over 12 custom quests.[/*]
[*]Complete bundles to unlock the town and a private living area![/*]
[*]The town consists of 12 Romanceable NPCs, 1 roommateable NPC, Custom wedding mechanics.
The romanceable NPCs are:
[spoiler] Arden, Blaise, Cassidy, Elara, Gustavo, Jax, Jett, Mara, Remy Riley, Roxy and Vance. Hisstopher is a roommate only.[/spoiler]
[/*]
[*]Unlock the Timberline Falls quest board featuring over 25 new special orders[/*]
[*]Create new crafting recipes, new cooking recipes and new artisan goods![/*]
[*]Five new machines (all compatible with Automate) and six custom bombs![/*]
[*]Explore nature in Timberfalls with a dozen new forage items and a fresh catch of 13 new fish![/*]
[*]Coming soon: Platonic relationship options![/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332579.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Timberline is pretty much self-contained. So it should be compatible with all major content mods.[/*]
[*]Compatible with Automate[/*]
[*]Recolor compatibility with DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54220/54220-1793481169-916226209.png[/img]
[list]
[*]VPR and additional recolor compatibility[/*]
[*]Platonic relationships[/*]
[*]TimberLine Dungeon[/*]
[*]Town expansion featuring more NPCs and tools[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img]

[/list]If you would like to create custom content of your own for Timberline, I will allow it with the following notes / Caveats:
[list=1]
[*]There are future plans for many areas. Do not be surprised if I take over a spot you liked for a house[/*]
[*]You may not move or change existing NPC homes locations. You are welcome to redo interiors but I ask you verify Major changes with me.[/*]
[*]You may have your NPCs interact with timberline NPCs. However you must keep the Timberline residents true to who they are. (Example. NO, Bernard did NOT decide your NPC is great and is his best friend and is the only person he isn't mean to). This applies to mods that add dialogue or revise NPCs. [/*]
[*]No explicit or derogatory NPCs are to be part of the town. They can be mean, unlikable, etc. but you can do that without racism, sexism, etc[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332750.png[/img]
